mentions.name: Quiet UI
mentions.description: Quiet UI is a web components library that prioritizes accessibility, longevity, performance, and simplicity. An autoloader loads components dynamically from a single script tag without downloading the entire library (npm also available). Theming uses color-mix() and OKLAB to create uniform color palettes from a single CSS property, with adaptive palettes for dark mode. Form controls are form-associated via ElementInternals and work with native validation APIs, and dialogs, popovers, and tooltips use the Popover API for top-layer access without portaling or hoisting. Fun components include Joystick, Stamp, Mesh Gradient, Flip Card, Random Content, Intersection Observer, Typewriter, Lorem Ipsum, and Slide Activator. The library is free for personal, educational, and non-profit use; commercial use requires a license.
